bio:
I am currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science at El Shorouk Academy, where I am building a rigorous foundation in algorithms, databases, and software architectures. Driven by an intense curiosity for artificial intelligence, I spend my self-directed hours studying machine learning models and optimizing agentic architectures.

My technical core spans languages like Python, C#, and C, combined with extensive, hands-on prompt engineering across industry-leading ecosystems such as GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Perplexity, and DeepSeek. I believe AI shouldn't just be an off-the-shelf integration; I strive to master the mathematical and architectural mechanisms behind them to create functional, responsive solutions.
